title: Rathelbecker Weg, Erkrath
description:
Entire apartment
Property Description:
The ~40m2 apartment is located on the elevated ground floor of a quiet multi-family building and was recently renovated. The apartment features triple-glazed windows and has been freshly painted. The spacious living area, with direct access to the balcony, provides a modern and cozy atmosphere. The contemporary bathroom with a walk-in shower was previously renovated. The apartment is fully furnished, making it ideal for one person or a couple looking for a peaceful environment with excellent transport connections.

Features:
• Fitted kitchen with washing machine, dishwasher, fridge with freezer, stove, oven, extractor hood, microwave, and various cooking utensils
• Large living/sleeping area with a 140 cm wide bed, pull-out couch with storage, and 55-inch flat-screen TV
• High-speed internet and cable TV
• Modern bathroom with walk-in shower
• Balcony with green views and balcony furniture
• Private cellar space
• Public parking spaces in front of the building

Additional Information
The apartment is located in a quiet residential area of Erkrath with excellent access to the A46 and A3 highways. Via the nearby Hilden motorway junction, both Düsseldorf and Wuppertal are easily reachable. The Erkrath S-Bahn station and the old town of Erkrath are within walking distance. The old town offers numerous shops, cafés, and a pharmacy, covering all essential daily needs. Additionally, the famous Neandertal is just a short drive away, offering a variety of recreational activities in nature.

title: Hüttenstraße, Erkrath
description:
PLEASE NOTE:
The listed rental price is the base rent. Additional required costs are listed. the 'all-in' rent is 1050 Euros for single person tenancy.

The special charm of this around 50 sqm large 2-room apartment is undoubtedly the wonderful location on the outskirts of Düsseldorf in Erkrath-Hochdahl with a view into the greenery of the Bruchhausen nature reserve. If you want to live conveniently but away from the hustle and bustle of the city and are looking for relaxation and tranquility after a busy day, you will feel right at home here.

By local train (S-Bahn) from Hochdahl station, Düsseldorf's main station can be reached in 10 minutes. 
By car you have a good transport connection via the freeway junction Hilden to the A3 and A46.

The apartment has room for 2 persons which should be a couple as there's only one bed-/livingroom. 
The basic rent listed is for a single person occupancy. I have added the optional costs for 2-person-occupancy as 'other optional costs'.

The apartment has a spacious, high-quality furnished living-dining area, a separate bedroom and a fully equipped kitchenette. The bathroom has been modernly renovated.

Furthermore, the apartment has a small terrace overlooking a part of the garden.

The equipment includes:
- a queen-size bed 140 cm x 200 cm (suitable for 2 persons)
- a sofa bed
- a bathroom with shower
- a fully equipped fitted kitchenette with electric stove, oven, dishwasher, microwave
- coffee maker, electric kettle
- access to washing machine and tumble dryer
- iron/ironing board
- bed linen and towels
- Television via DVB-S
- high speed internet.

Maximum occupancy is 2 adults and a child.

Please note that all our apartments are non-smoking accommodations. However, if there is smoking in the apartment, extensive cleaning will be required. We ask for your understanding that we will charge the resulting costs of up to 1,000.00 Euros.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!

title: Johannesberger Straße, Erkrath
description: Bright and fully furnished room in a welcoming shared house in Erkrath-Hochdahl. The room offers a separate sleeping area, desk, office chair, wardrobe and plenty of storage. A modern bathroom is shared with only two other residents. Shared kitchen, washing machine, Wi-Fi, terrace and garden are available. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible. Quiet green area with good connections to Düsseldorf.
